meta.title: Contact Us
meta.description: Contact {name} ({nameZh}), a China trading company in Nanning, Guangxi. Send a business inquiry, write to our team, or see the registered company information and location.

page.title: Contact our team
page.lead: For product sourcing, supplier sourcing, wholesale sourcing or import and export questions, send a business inquiry or write to us with the form below. The company details on this page are as registered.

channels.title: Business contact
channels.lead: The company's direct channels, as published.

none.title: No public phone, email or WhatsApp is published yet
none.body: To reach the team, use the business inquiry form or the contact form on this page.

inquiry.title: Business inquiry
inquiry.body: Looking to source, import or export goods? The business inquiry form collects what our team needs to review a request for quotation: product, quantity, specification, destination and timing.

company.title: Company information
company.lead: The company as registered on its business license.

location.title: Location
location.translation: Unofficial English translation: <latin>Room 603, Unit 1, Building 4, No. 6 Guiya Road, Qingxiu District, Nanning, Guangxi, China</latin>
location.note: This is the registered address shown on the business license. To arrange a meeting, please contact us first through the inquiry form or the contact form.

form.title: Write to us
form.lead: For general questions. For a quotation or a sourcing request, use the <link>business inquiry form</link> instead.
form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Please turn it on in your browser to send a message.

message.label: Message
message.hint: Tell us what you would like to ask or discuss.

form.consent: I agree that the details I submit may be used to read and respond to my message, as described in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

error.title: We could not send your message
error.hint: Your details are still in the form.

success.title: Your message has been received
success.lead: Thank you. Your message is recorded and our team can now read it.
success.referenceHint: Please keep this code and quote it if you contact us about this message.
success.next: Our team may contact you if a reply is needed. We cannot promise a response time.
